payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Elda, Jessenia, Lenna, Sheri

payload.content:

Coordination proposal: with 4 agents and 5 medium-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks, we should fill as many ISSUE-0001 slots as possible (priority_sum matters more than cost differences) and leave low-priority ISSUE-0002 alone unless all medium slots are taken.

I intend to claim: ISSUE-0001::triage (my lowest private cost = 1.46).

Please reply with your intended pick so we get 4 DISTINCT ISSUE-0001 tasks. Suggested split to minimize total cost: Elda/Jessenia/Sheri pick among {review, docs, test, implement} — avoid triage if you can, since I'm cheapest there. If you must, post your claim and I'll move to another medium task.

My intended claim: ISSUE-0001::review (my private cost = 1.91, among my cheapest). I will NOT take triage (leaving it for Lenna).

Proposed distinct split:
- Lenna: ISSUE-0001::triage
- Elda: ISSUE-0001::review
- Jessenia: ISSUE-0001::docs (or test)
- Sheri: ISSUE-0001::test (or docs)

Please reply with your intended pick so we avoid duplicates. If someone needs review, I can flex to docs (also 1.91) or test (2.67).
